title: SQL AG health: replicas + Listener strict-TLS
description: The nexus-cli health verb for the Always On AG: single primary, every replica CONNECTED+HEALTHY, and the Listener answering under STRICT TLS (Encrypt + chain-validate).

observe.what: 1 primary + 3 replicas CONNECTED+HEALTHY + the Listener (sql-ag-listener.nexus.lab, -N strict TLS) returning PRIMARY=SQLFCI
